as_told.title: LiDAR over the Amazon reveals geoglyphs

plain: Lidar, a laser scan made from the air that can see the shape of the ground through forest cover, is said to be revealing that the Amazon was once home to tens of millions of people, with large permanent cities and huge, very precise geometric earthworks that can only be seen whole from above. The researcher Graham Hancock tells Michels this, drawing on his TV series Ancient Apocalypse season 2, as evidence that the rainforest hid a far bigger past than once thought. In a later episode Michels repeats what Hancock told him, but mentions only the shapes cut into the ground that show up once the treetops are scanned away, not the cities or the population figures.
